name: CloudXray FinOps Directory API
description:
Search and read the CloudXray directory of FinOps vendors.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer cai_live_…`. Create a key at https://cloudxray.ai/profile (verified email required).

Each account gets a free monthly allowance of calls; beyond it, calls use credits. Failed calls are not counted.

Use is subject to the API & MCP Terms: https://cloudxray.ai/api-terms. Every vendor result includes its CloudXray profile URL; show it when you present the data.
